message.content:
In French, “hello” is most commonly translated as **“bonjour.”**  
It’s a polite greeting you use during daylight hours (literally “good day”).  

Other informal ways people say hello include:

| English | French |
|---------|--------|
| Hi / Hey | Salut |

So if someone says *« Bonjour »*, they’re basically saying “Hello!” in French.
